Initial release of Short Video Script skill.

- Instantly generates complete, platform-optimized scripts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Douyin, and Xiaohongshu.
- Features proven hook structures, visual/audio cues, platform-specific adaptations, detailed shot lists, and multiple copy variants.
- Includes trending format templates and optimized CTAs for each platform.
- Supports classic frameworks: problem/solution, story arc, listicle, before/after, POV, and reaction/duet.
- Fast turnaround from script concept to shot list for viral-ready short videos.
